warnings: ST-04 is the internal stair marked on S-02 (bay A-B x 2-3); its only detail is this architectural sheet, extracted here because it carries the stair's structural members (steel 2C-150x50x20x3.2 stringers, landing beams and posts). The stair plan and section are two views of one element, so they share this file.
Steel members carry no mark — element_id null with element_name_assigned (section 0.2). The landing-beam callout points at three members but prints no count, so count is null.

The plan chain (1.700 = 1.100 + 0.600 from grid 2; 3.300 = 1.000 + 2.300 from A) is recorded in the grid master (2', 2'', A'''). The section chains carry no grid marker or level label and stay on the ST-04 element.
